metadata.title: Rubén Carmona Fortuño - Full Stack Developer
metadata.description: Full Stack Developer specialized in Node.js and Angular. Based in Vila-real, Comunidad Valenciana, working remotely.

hero.subtitle: Full Stack Developer: APIs, interfaces and deployment. I take products end to end, with a focus on clean, reliable code.

about.title: About me
about.p1: Full stack developer based in Vila-real, working remotely since 2018. I've taken products from business requirement to production: backend in Node.js, maintainable interfaces in Angular and, more recently, in React too.
about.p2: What I enjoy most is turning unclear requirements into products people actually use, with a focus on clean code and architecture decisions that hold up over time.

revenueLabs.summary: Multi-tenant (white-label) online booking platform used by more than 50 clients to sell ticket, hotel and train packages from their own domains.
bullets: Booking APIs and pricing/discount logic with rules by age, height and fare type.
Angular 19 frontend with SSR and full hydration on a single codebase serving dozens of brands.
End-to-end integration of the Redsys payment gateway, from checkout to transaction confirmation.
CI/CD with GitHub Actions and infrastructure on GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Redis) with Terraform and Docker.

nttData.summary: Full stack development on client projects: backend in PHP/Symfony and frontend in AngularJS.

anaimo.summary: AI software development, applying machine learning to real use cases.

arenaStack.summary: Technical lead and full stack development, taking part in architecture and product decisions.

project.tagline: Real-time multiplayer word game with an ELO ranking
project.description: Turn-based online word game: each match sets a prefix and players race to chain valid words before time runs out. Includes a real-time versus mode, a daily challenge, solo practice and private link-based lobbies.
bullets: Real time with Socket.IO: turns, timers and word validation kept in sync across clients.
Account system with JWT and bcrypt, plus an ELO ranking that moves up or down with each match's result.
Express + MongoDB backend, Angular frontend; rate limiting and security headers with Helmet.

contact.subtitle: Open to new remote opportunities. Email me or reach out on LinkedIn and I'll reply within 24 hours.
